profile.headline: Senior Front-End Developer | CMS Systems Architect | Agency & White-Label Technical Partner
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Front-End Developer and CMS Systems Architect with 6+ years of experience engineering scalable marketing and e-commerce platforms across WordPress, Shopify, and Webflow environments.

My focus goes beyond page builds. I architect and oversee the full website lifecycle including platform selection, technical structure, hosting and DNS configuration, deployment workflows, analytics implementation using GA4 and GTM, CRM integrations, and payment systems. I operate at the intersection of creative vision and technical execution, ensuring digital systems are reliable, performant, and built to scale.

With a Master’s in Software Engineering and extensive agency experience, I serve as a technical partner to design and marketing teams, translating complex ideas into stable, maintainable infrastructure that supports growth long after launch.

Long term, my goal is to lead and architect development departments within creative agencies, building systems and teams that deliver high performance digital experiences at scale.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Architect and oversee full website build lifecycle including hosting configuration, DNS management, deployment workflows, analytics integration, and payment system implementation.
• Translate brand and web design systems into scalable CMS architectures across WordPress, Shopify, Showit, and Squarespace.
• Define technical structure and implementation approach for custom marketing websites and small business platforms.
• Optimize performance, improve load times, and ensure responsive consistency across devices and browsers.
• Conduct comprehensive QA processes including unit testing, end-to-end testing, and cross-browser validation prior to launch.
• Implement custom functionality and integrations using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and PHP.
positions.insights: Skills: WordPress · Web Hosting · Shopify · JavaScript · PHP · Webflow · HTML5 · DNS Management · Squarespace · WooCommerce · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Google Tag Manager · Web Performance · GreenSock Animation Platform (GSAP) · REST APIs · Stripe (Software) · Adobe XD · Shopyflow

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
• Participated in client discovery and requirements gathering to translate business objectives into scalable technical solutions and development roadmaps.

• Architected and implemented a responsive-first development workflow to ensure performance, accessibility, and cross-device consistency across projects.

• Translated high-fidelity designs from Adobe XD and Figma into production-ready websites, maintaining pixel accuracy while optimizing for usability and speed.

• Developed, refactored, and optimized web functionality using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and PHP across custom and CMS-driven environments.

• Executed comprehensive QA processes including user testing, cross-browser testing, snapshot testing, end-to-end testing, and pre-launch debugging to ensure stability and reliability.

• Successfully launched and maintained websites across multiple platforms including WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, and other hosted CMS ecosystems.

positions.description:

Design and develop custom landing pages collaborating with the marketing team.

positions.title: Biomedical Engineer II
positions.description:
➢ Responsible in the maintaining of various forms of ventilators, defibrillators, pumps and other forms of biomedical equipment for over 250 medical facilities in the area.
➢ Manage communication with various suppliers to ensure quality inventory is maintained.
➢ Maintained the ERP control system with relation to inventory and software issues that may arise over time.
➢ Repair and maintain medical equipment such as IV pumps, defibrillators, hospital beds, feeding pumps, ventilators and more. *Certified in Philips V60, Puritan Bennett 840 and Hamilton G5 ventilators.

positions.title: Biomedical Engineer
positions.description:
➢ Developed an infrastructure to maintain dozens of defibrillators, surgical tables, intravenous and drug administration pumps which achieved the hospital a ranking in the top 10% of the nation’s top hospitals
for patient safety.
➢ Responsible for spearheading teams that handled maintenance and software development for the doctor offices affiliated with Sebastian River Medical Center which reduced equipment breakdowns by 75%.
➢ Monitored various merchant relations and projects for the assurance of equipment optimization.

positions.title: Quality/Service Engineer
positions.description:
•	Upgraded Mago 4S EIA/Automated System (used in Immunological testing)
•	Strengthen various other In-Vitro Diagnostic testing machines
•	Increased quality assurance ratings
•	Projected instrument turnover and output rate by 46%

positions.title: Engineering Team Lead
positions.description:
•	Directed a team of 4 to design and build a microfluidic device that would be used in FT IR Spectroscopy 
•	Set the goal to decrease the time needed to perform an analysis on FT IR Spectroscopy
•	Improved the design of windows, which projected a 66% reduction time

projects.title: Matlab Action Potential Project
projects.description: Designed and coded for the action potential within a neuron based on the Hodgkin-Huxley equations to determine ion transport, resting membrane potential, thresholds, and refractory period.

projects.title: Multi-Sample Device for FT IR Spectroscopy
projects.description: The purpose of this project was to deliver a device to be used to load samples onto an FT-IR spectrometer for analysis as well as a lock-in-frame for the windows to help load the samples and rotate between them during the different studies. The new device must accommodate multiple samples to be analyzed in one trial, while maintaining constant medium path lengths between buffers and proteins samples.  Also, a mechanism to move the windows between sample analysis was be delivered. During this process, feasibility assessment and design verifications was also be performed.
